disposition: retain as the Gemini-CLI provider build; candidate only

execution.alternatives: bounded read-only delegation for audit/critique evidence; worktrees do not isolate loopback helper ports or the browser
execution.recommended: in-session agentic runs; critique mandates two isolated sub-agents, live needs dev server plus browser

invocation: explicit /impeccable with sub-command; no-argument shows the routing menu and never auto-runs
limitations: No live harness evaluation: no browser, dev server, image generation, or hook installation run.
No license file in-tree; only two Apache-2.0 SPDX headers, so redistribution rights are unknown.
Upstream version beyond frontmatter 4.1.1 unverified; GEMINI.md Design Context writer unspecified in-tree.
Maintenance ownership and merge/retirement vs six sibling variants remain human decisions.
pack: provider-scoped frontend-design craft for Gemini CLI projects, not universal core

questions.question: Should this Gemini entrypoint declare license and invocation metadata in its frontmatter?
questions.rationale: The Claude sibling declares license, argument-hint, user-invocable, and allowed-tools; Gemini loader support for those keys is unverified.
questions.recommendation: Add them only after Gemini loader support is verified; the REVIEW carries the license gap until then.

questions.question: On a Gemini-CLI-only project, should `hooks on` report that no hook surface exists?
questions.rationale: Manifest targets cover .claude/.agents/.cursor/.github only, so `on` repairs nothing on a pure Gemini project without saying why.
questions.recommendation: Document hookless operation (MANUAL_DETECTOR_REQUIRED) as the expected Gemini state.

questions.question: Should the first OpenAI-fallback image call in a session require explicit cost confirmation?
questions.rationale: The fallback spends the user's own API credit per image; the header says the skill states cost first, but no gate enforces it.
questions.recommendation: Keep explicit pre-call cost disclosure; never persist the user's key.

questions.question: Should the daily-throttled version check against impeccable.style stay default-on?
questions.rationale: Boot-time network egress with silent failure is a standing behavior users did not opt into per project.
questions.recommendation: Keep the throttled silent-fail default and document the host opt-out.

questions.question: Should the tree pin the upstream version and license of modern-screenshot.umd.js?
questions.rationale: The minified bundle ships with no recorded version or license, so updates and redistribution review have no anchor.
questions.recommendation: Pin upstream version and license before promotion.

questions.question: Should auto mode learn a Gemini CLI wake path for staged copy-edit Apply?
questions.rationale: Only codex/claude CLIs are woken; Gemini-only machines degrade to the inline path, which may be intended but is unstated.
questions.recommendation: Confirm whether a Gemini CLI path is wanted or degraded-inline remains the contract.

validation: node --check over all 107 scripts pass; command-metadata.json parses with 23 commands.
